name: Mournful Petals Haunt
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A flurry of scattered flower petals flies through the area, as psychic impressions of pain, sorrow, and being trapped assail the living—Mirida's scattered memories.
disable: DC 31 Occultism or DC 31 Religion (expert) to weaken the haunt, DC 29 Deception or DC 29 Diplomacy (expert) to soothe the haunt's sorrow; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The petals disperse after 1 minute and reset after 1 day.
routine: (1 action) The flower petals surge through the room, dealing (2d10+13) Slashing Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails is additionally Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Scattered Memories
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the area

Effect Fragments of Mirida's scattered thoughts and memories manifest in the room as flower petals, the sounds of weeping, whimpers of pain, and shrieks echo through the area, dealing (2d10+13) Mental Damage damage to all intelligent creatures in the area (Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save). The haunt then rolls initiative.
